beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: London makes the week visible as a relay among institutional schedule, temporary room, camera, platform, labor, commerce and archive. This chapter follows commerce: Between runway attention and an order sit identifiers, line sheets, showrooms, buyer permissions and product records whose adoption is often claimed faster than it is proved.
beats.onScreen: Then: Physical line sheets and buyer appointments are the proposed historic entry point, pending a London-specific primary artifact.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: Physical line sheets and buyer appointments are the proposed historic entry point, pending a London-specific primary artifact. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The BFC’s 2021 platform brief explicitly required journeys for retailers and buyers and framed designer return through e-commerce and wholesale opportunities; it named digital showrooms and retailer orders as intended platform functions.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation entered into force on 18 July 2024 and establishes a framework that includes digital product passports; it is not a BFC-owned plan.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger
